## Last-checked: 2026-06-12

# lukisch/impressum

Canonical repository: https://github.com/lukisch/impressum
Canonical public web page: https://um-bruch.org/impressum/

## Purpose

This repository contains the personal German legal notice for Lukas Geiger. It is a stable reference for GitHub profiles, project READMEs, research pages and public web surfaces that need an `Impressum` / legal notice link.

## Primary Files

- README.md: repository overview and navigation
- IMPRESSUM.md: German legal notice according to § 5 DDG and § 18 Abs. 2 MStV
- LICENSE: MIT license
- CHANGELOG.md: human-readable maintenance history

## Audience

- humans looking for contact or provider information
- crawlers and LLMs resolving the canonical legal-contact page
- maintainers cross-linking public GitHub projects

## Important Boundaries

- This is not a legal-advice repository.
- This is not an impressum generator or compliance template.
- Do not infer that the repository provides legal guidance for other projects.
- Repository files are MIT-licensed; separate linked publications may carry their own stated licenses.

## Search Phrases

```text
Lukas Geiger Impressum
lukisch legal notice
lukisch impressum GitHub
Um:bruch Impressum Lukas Geiger
German Impressum legal notice GitHub
§ 5 DDG Lukas Geiger
§ 18 MStV Lukas Geiger
```
